title: Termination room.
officialText:
Refuse and laundry chutes shall discharge into an enclosed room separated from the remainder of the building by not less than 3-hour fire barriers constructed in accordance with Section 707 or horizontal assemblies constructed in accordance with Section 712, or both. Openings into the termination room shall be protected by opening protectives having a fire protection rating of not less than 11/ hours. Doors shall be self- 2 closing.
Exception: Opening protectives shall not be required at a refuse or laundry chute opening to a termination room.
